STATION BRIEFING / IMPACT & RESONANCE

Conduct the cookware.

A mallet and a burst of noise put energy into a vibrating body. Its resonances turn that impact into a drum, bell, or string. The kitchen calls this a perfectly reasonable use of a saucepan.

Build your beat

Click a step to add a hit. Shift + click for an accent. Edit step, right-click, E on a focused step, or a touchscreen hold opens per-hit sound overrides. Select a voice to shape it. M mutes a track; S hears it solo. Choose 16 or 32 steps above the grid; at 32, use 1–16 / 17–32 to edit either half. Returning to 16 keeps the second half for later. Pattern banks A–D hold four variations. Chain beside the banks arranges whole patterns with repeats, reordering, and loop or once playback. Per-hit locks and all chain edits save with projects and support Undo.

Find your body

Choose one of nine resonators, including a bell, a singing bowl, and a tube. Tune its pitch, structure, decay, damping, and strike position. Motion + mix adds movement and places the voice in the stereo field.

Two effects per voice

Open either GALLEY slot under the selected voice’s controls. Choose any studio effect, then edit its controls or choose a recipe. The two slots run in order before CLATTER’s master mix. Each voice has its own effects and tails; your project, samples, WAVs and printed parts retain them. Bypass, Reset and Remove stay inside the effect editor.

Choose your contact

Exciter offers felt, rubber, wood, nylon, ceramic, and metal alongside the original neutral mallet. Each shapes the contact differently. Refine hardness and contact time, add surface texture, or let the mallet rebound. Noise has its own color, filter, and envelope. Drag knobs vertically; hold Shift for fine adjustments.

Keep a good idea

Your changes save in this browser automatically. Save project downloads an editable JSON file; the folder opens it again. Export WAV renders four bars with a natural decay tail as a stereo audio file.

At your fingertips

Space Play / pause · 1–8 Audition · Ctrl / ⌘ Z Undo
↑ ↓ Adjust a focused knob · Shift + click Accent a step

Works offline. Synthesized from impact and resonance.

Inspired by exciter/resonator instruments such as Intellijel Plonk. Original browser implementation.

Pattern chain

Each entry plays a complete pattern. Changes enter at the next pattern boundary; the grid stays on the bank you are editing.

Uncheck Loop for one pass with natural tails.

Up to 32 entries, 1–16 repeats each, and 256 beats. Clear and every chain edit support Undo. Audio exports are limited to 120 seconds.

Step sound

Uncheck Inherit to change only this strike. Check it to return to the voice. Output cutoff filters the whole hit, including the resonator.
